title: Technician I Canopy Work-Order Record
description: A controlled record for interpreting and executing canopy work while preserving plant identity, sanitation, tissue condition, exceptions, and handoff.
instructions: Record the defined work-order objective before selecting an action.
Identify stressed, damaged, suspect, or ambiguous plants before irreversible work begins.
Document completed scope, exceptions, damage, sanitation, and before-and-after references.
Stop and escalate when supplied limits or authority boundaries are reached.
limitations: This record does not authorize personal training experiments or changes to production strategy.
Facility work orders and stop conditions govern the actual task.
publicationNote: Owner-approved academic learner support. Not a facility SOP, regulated production record, assessor score sheet, or professional credential issuance instrument.
